title: The OCUDU dApp Platform: An Open Runtime and E3 Interface for Real-Time AI-RAN
abstract: arXiv:2609.07843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning has shown its largest gains in the band below 10 ms inside a 3GPP new radio (NR) 5G distributed unit (DU): link adaptation, per-slot scheduling, channel estimation, and the receiver itself. No open platform has let independently built software run there. Prior dApp frameworks reached the band only as external observers of an export stream. This paper is a guided introduction to the OCUDU dApp platform, an open runtime and E3 interface under which signed AI-RAN applications execute inside a production DU under three timing contracts: resident on the GPU receive chain (Class A), inside the scheduler's 100 us admitted deadline (Class B), or as never-blocking observers whose results the scheduler consumes (Class C). The conventional path is never displaced, and every authority is typed, validated, and operator-bounded. The paper explains how the runtime, the embedded E3 agent, and the three public repositories fit together

translated_title: OCUDU dApp 平台：面向实时 AI-RAN 的开放运行时与 E3 接口
translated_abstract: 机器学习在 3GPP 新空口（NR）5G 分布式单元（DU）内 10 毫秒以下的时延区间展现出最大收益，应用场景包括链路自适应、逐时隙调度、信道估计以及接收机本身。然而此前没有任何开放平台允许独立开发的软件在该区间内运行，先前的 dApp 框架只能作为导出流的外部观察者进入这一领域。本文是对 OCUDU dApp 平台的导引性介绍，该平台是一个开放运行时与 E3 接口，经过签名的 AI-RAN 应用可在生产 DU 内部按照三种时序契约执行：驻留在 GPU 接收链上（A 类）、在调度器 100 微秒的准入截止时间内运行（B 类），或作为永不阻塞的观察者、其结果由调度器消费（C 类）。传统处理路径始终不会被取代，且每项权限都经过类型化、验证并受运营商约束。论文还阐述了运行时、嵌入式 E3 代理以及三个公开代码库之间的协作方式。
tldr: OCUDU dApp 平台首次提供了开放运行时和 E3 接口，使经过签名的 AI-RAN 应用能够在生产 5G 分布式单元内部，按照三种时序契约（GPU 接收链驻留、100 微秒调度截止时间、非阻塞观察者）实时运行，填补了机器学习在 10 毫秒以下超低时延区间的开放平台空白。
en_tdlr: The OCUDU dApp platform provides the first open runtime and E3 interface enabling signed AI-RAN applications to execute inside a production 5G distributed unit under three timing contracts, opening the sub-10ms ultra-low latency band to independently built software.
